def process(waterBodyTesting2012, waterBodyTesting2013) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    def find_col(df, candidates):
        cols = {c.lower(): c for c in df.columns}
        for cand in candidates:
            if cand.lower() in cols:
                return cols[cand.lower()]
        # fuzzy contains
        for c in df.columns:
            cl = c.lower()
            for cand in candidates:
                if cand.lower() in cl:
                    return c
        return None

    # Identify key columns
    beach12 = find_col(waterBodyTesting2012, ["beach", "beach_name", "beach name", "location", "site", "station"])
    beach13 = find_col(waterBodyTesting2013, ["beach", "beach_name", "beach name", "location", "site", "station"])

    exceed12 = find_col(waterBodyTesting2012, ["bacterial exceedance", "bacterial_exceedance", "exceedance", "exceeded", "exceed", "exceedance_flag", "beachadvisory", "advisory"])
    exceed13 = find_col(waterBodyTesting2013, ["bacterial exceedance", "bacterial_exceedance", "exceedance", "exceeded", "exceed", "exceedance_flag", "beachadvisory", "advisory"])

    # If exceed columns not found, try common numeric columns like 'E. coli' vs threshold isn't feasible here;
    # require an exceedance indicator.
    if beach12 is None or beach13 is None or exceed12 is None or exceed13 is None:
        # return diagnostics
        return pd.DataFrame([{
            "error": "Required columns not found",
            "2012_columns": ", ".join(map(str, waterBodyTesting2012.columns)),
            "2013_columns": ", ".join(map(str, waterBodyTesting2013.columns)),
            "beach12": beach12,
            "beach13": beach13,
            "exceed12": exceed12,
            "exceed13": exceed13,
        }])

    def to_bool(s: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
        # normalize common representations
        x = s.copy()
        if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(x):
            return x
        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(x):
            # assume 1 indicates exceedance
            return x.fillna(0).astype(float) != 0
        x = x.astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
        true_set = {"true", "t", "yes", "y", "1", "exceed", "exceeded", "exceedance", "e", "advisory", "posted"}
        false_set = {"false", "f", "no", "n", "0", "ok", "none", "not exceeded", "notexceeded", "not exceed", "not_exceed"}
        out = pd.Series([None] * len(x), index=x.index, dtype="boolean")
        out[x.isin(true_set)] = True
        out[x.isin(false_set)] = False
        # fallback: if contains 'exceed'
        out[out.isna() & x.str.contains("exceed", na=False)] = True
        out = out.fillna(False)
        return out.astype(bool)

    df12 = waterBodyTesting2012[[beach12, exceed12]].copy()
    df13 = waterBodyTesting2013[[beach13, exceed13]].copy()
    df12.columns = ["beach", "exceed"]
    df13.columns = ["beach", "exceed"]

    df12["beach"] = df12["beach"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df13["beach"] = df13["beach"].astype(str).str.strip()

    df12["exceed"] = to_bool(df12["exceed"])
    df13["exceed"] = to_bool(df13["exceed"])

    # Compute exceedance rate per beach: mean(exceed) over all samples
    agg12 = df12.groupby("beach").agg(samples12=("exceed", "size"), exceedRate12=("exceed", "mean")).reset_index()
    agg13 = df13.groupby("beach").agg(samples13=("exceed", "size"), exceedRate13=("exceed", "mean")).reset_index()

    comp = agg12.merge(agg13, on="beach", how="inner")
    # Excluding those with no samples in 2012: inner join already ensures beach present in 2012; also enforce samples12>0
    comp = comp[comp["samples12"] > 0]

    higher = (comp["exceedRate13"] > comp["exceedRate12"]).sum()
    return pd.DataFrame([{"higherCount": int(higher)}])
